**P1 — Keep one retry budget around configuration reads**

`getCurrentConfiguration()` now performs 10 exponential-backoff attempts, but this call is also inside the create/update `retryOnConflict` loop (120 attempts for capacity-provider deployments). Persistent throttling can therefore trigger up to 1,200 reads and roughly four hours of backoff. Keep this read raw inside the phase-level retry and wrap only standalone polling reads, or otherwise prevent the outer loop from resetting an exhausted read budget.
